name: HNS_INVESTIGATIONS_SUMMARY
description: HNS INVESTIGATIONS SUMMARY. This table stores all investigation related data.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_ID
columns.description: Unique Investigation Identifier. Primary key for HNS_INVESTIGATIONS_SUMMARY table.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_NO
columns.description: Unique user generated Investigation  Identifier.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_DATE
columns.description: The date the investigation was initiated by the investigation owner.

columns.name: INCIDENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Incident Identifier. Foreign key for HNS_INCIDENTS_SUMMARY table.

columns.name: INCIDENT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique Incidents Event identifier. Foreign key for HNS_INCIDENTS_DETAIL.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_SUMMARY
columns.description: The user entered summary on the investigation.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of investigation. This signifies the level of investigation. Low level, high level.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The employee ID of ther person who owns the investigation. The investigation owner will always be an employee.

columns.name: INVEST_OWNER_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: The Assignment ID of ther person who owns the investigation. The investigation owner will always be an employee.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Deleted Flag.Signifies whether investigation is deleted.

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: Completed Flag. Signifies whether Investigation is completed

columns.name: INVEST_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: INVEST_STATUS_CODE column: Current InVESTIGATION  Status. Lookup to FND_LOOKUP STATUS.

columns.name: TARGET_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Target Completion date for an investigation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Actual completion date for an investigation

columns.name: LESSONS_LEARNED
columns.description: Lessons Learned.

columns.name: INVESTIGATE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description entered by the user for the investigation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INVEST_REVIEWER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to investigation reviewer.

columns.name: INVEST_APPROVER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to investigation approver.

columns.name: INVEST_PRECOM_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to investigation precom approver.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: To store the Questionnaire referenced by the Investigation.
